distinct_from.GENERAL_IT: GENERAL_IT runs a public help desk (accounts, services, DNS, change windows). IT_SUPPORT_HARDWARE is the refurb bench: power budgets, memory channels, RAID, partition schemes, fault isolation, display bandwidth, UPS runtime, imaging, and sanitization.
distinct_from.HARDWARE_ENGINEERING: HARDWARE_ENGINEERING designs circuits and boards (SPICE, Thevenin, PCB ERC/DRC, Zephyr). IT_SUPPORT_HARDWARE services finished PCs and does not design hardware.
